patch_description: This approach prunes the overly complex ansatz from the current program (which has 74 parameters) to a leaner, more parameter-efficient design (38 parameters). By implementing coarse-grained parameter sharing across two 4-qubit banks and focusing on an interleaved CZ-ring entanglement topology, we reduce the search space dimension. This helps the Adam optimizer converge more robustly, prevents overfitting, and improves the generalization gap, as evidenced by the high performance of similar configurations.
